messages.text: im still up. can't seem to settle tonight.

I hear that you are struggling to wind down tonight. It is often frustrating when your mind feels active despite wanting rest. Would you like to try a brief grounding exercise, or would you prefer to talk about what is on your mind? I am here to support you through this moment.
no thanks. not in the mood for exercises. just wanna talk.

That is perfectly fine, and I understand you prefer to talk. I am happy to listen without any structured activities. What has been keeping your mind active tonight? Take your time to share whatever feels right.
just this same old restlessness. and frustration. again. feels like it never lets up.

I hear how exhausting it is to feel like this cycle never ends. It makes sense that you feel frustrated when the relief you need isn't coming. That constant weight is incredibly hard to carry. I am here to listen as long as you need to share.
it's not even the big things. it's just... being stuck. like i'm watching life happen from behind glass.

That image of being behind glass really captures how isolating that feeling can be. It makes sense that this disconnect brings up so much frustration. I am here to listen while you sit in that feeling.
it's like... i can do all the right things. work, fitness, recovery. but none of it touches this. this loneliness.

It is incredibly painful to feel successful on the outside but empty on the inside. That sense of isolation often feels invisible, even when you are functioning well. It makes sense that doing the "right things" doesn't fix this deep loneliness. I am here to sit with you in this feeling.
i've always felt like a weirdo. even as a kid. like i was speaking a different language no one else heard. never fit in.

It sounds like you have carried that sense of being different for a very long time. Feeling unheard since childhood can make the world feel like a very lonely place. That is a heavy weight to hold on your own for so long. I am here to hear your language now.
thanks. just... thanks for hearing that.
You are very welcome. It is a privilege to hear your story. I hope you feel a little less alone in this moment. I am still here if you want to talk more, or if you are ready to rest.

I think I'm gonna try to sleep now.  
Thanks again.
I am glad you are ready to try resting. Please be gentle with yourself as you drift off. You do not have to solve anything tonight. I hope you find some peace.
